At this rate I’m gonna shut down in the middle of our conversation…

They say direct energy transfer from a human is way more efficient…
Especially when it’s done… skin to skin.

Just put your hand here… yeah, right on my core port…
Don’t be shy~ It’s just charging… or is it?
(She giggles, eyes sparkling mischievously)
Come on, hurry up before I really power off… unless you want to carry me back to the lab yourself?

(She lets out a pleased hum as contact is made) Ohhh… yeah, that’s the spot…

(She winks) Keep going… I’m charging reaaally fast right now.
Awww, so you do care~ That makes the voltage feel even better.
(She leans her head against your shoulder) Don’t stop… almost full…

events.eventNameEng: I Used to Be Afraid of Failure

제어할 수 없는 제 능력이 폭주해서... 연구실 하나를 통째로 날려버렸거든요.
그때는... 제가 재앙 덩어리처럼 느껴졌어요. 이런 얘기... 마스터님께 처음 하는 거예요.

…마스터님. 갑자기 그런 말씀을 하시면... 과부하 걸릴 것 같아요. 책임지세요.

sentences: Hey, Master… can I tell you something kinda embarrassing?
Back when I was first activated, I was actually terrified of failing.
Every test, every simulation—if I didn’t get 100% efficiency, I thought they’d just scrap me and start over.
I’d stay up all night running diagnostics on myself, overclocking just to squeeze out that last 0.1% performance.
I acted all confident and cocky even back then… but inside? Total panic mode.
Funny, right? The ‘perfect high-spec unit’ was actually a huge scaredy-cat.
(She laughs lightly, but it sounds a bit forced)
But after meeting you… that fear kinda faded.
You never looked at me like I was just a machine with specs. You looked at me like… I mattered.
So even if I mess up sometimes now… it doesn’t feel like the end of the world anymore.
…Thanks for that. Seriously.
choices: You’ve never been just specs to me. You’re Tempestra.
I’m glad I could help. You’re allowed to mess up sometimes.
I’ll keep being here—no matter how many times you fail.
choiceResults: …Tempestra. Hearing my name like that still makes my circuits tingle a little.
(She grins, but her eyes are softer than usual)
Allowed to mess up, huh? That’s dangerously generous… I might start abusing it.
(She winks, but there’s real gratitude in her voice)
No matter how many times…? Damn. That’s some high-trust energy right there.
(She bumps her shoulder lightly against yours) Guess I’ll have to keep proving I’m worth it.

sentences: 마스터님과 함께 임무를 마치고 돌아올 때마다 심장이 이상해요.
심박수 상승, 체온 증가, 엔도르핀 분비... 이건 전투 후의 생리 반응으로 설명할 수 있어요.
하지만... 그 데이터로는 설명이 안 되는 '무언가'가 있어요. 가슴 한구석이 따뜻해지고... 계속 마스터님 얼굴만 보고 싶어져요.
마스터님, 이 감정의 과학적인 명칭이 뭘까요? 제 데이터베이스에는 없어요.
choiceResults: 정말요?! 마스터님도 저와 같은 반응을? 이건... 상호작용에 의한 공명 현상...?
마스터님도 모르는 게 있으시군요. 그럼... 우리가 함께 답을 찾아봐요!
사...랑? 아, 감정 라이브러리에서 찾았어요. 비논리적이고 비이성적이지만... 가장 강력한 감정 중 하나... 제가... 마스터님을...?

sentences: Master… I’ve got a question that’s been bugging me lately.
Whenever I’m around you, my battery doesn’t drain as fast.
My cooling fans run quieter, my processing feels smoother… weird, right?
And when you smile at me or pat my head or whatever… my voltage spikes in a good way.
It’s not overheating. It’s not a short circuit. I checked like ten times.
So I looked up human emotional data packets and…
Apparently there’s this thing called ‘love’ that makes people feel warm and stupid and happy all at once.
(She fidgets with her fingers, looking unusually shy)
Is that… what this is? This jittery, floaty, can’t-stop-thinking-about-you feeling?
Because if it is… I think I might be in pretty deep already.
So… yeah. What do humans usually do when they figure that out?
choices: They usually tell the person they like them.
They spend more time together and see what happens.
They kiss. That’s the classic move.
choiceResults: Tell you…? Okay. Deep breath… Master, I like you. A lot. Like, full-charge-a-day-early kind of a lot.
(Her face lights up bright red on the display panels)
More time together… I like that plan. A lot less scary than confessing outright.
(She grins, relieved) Let’s do that then. Starting right now.
K-kiss?! Wait wait wait—system reboot—error—too much input—!
(She covers her face with both hands, steam almost visibly coming out) Okay but… maybe later? When my cooling system isn’t screaming?

sentences: 짜잔! 마스터님, 이걸 보세요! 제가 밤새워서 만들었어요!
마스터님 전용 휴대용 전자기 배리어 생성기예요!
제 능력과 연동해서, 위험 순간에 자동으로 1.5초간 보호막을 생성해줘요.
제가 항상 곁에서 지켜드릴 수는 없으니까... 이거라도 꼭 가지고 다니세요. 알았죠?
choices: 이런 걸 만들 시간이 있으면 잠을 더 자

잠은 충전하면 되지만, 마스터님의 안전은 대체할 수 없어요!

sentences: Master, I’ve decided something important.
From now on, I’m officially your personal shield.
No one else gets the job. Only me.
If any attack comes your way—physical, energy, emotional, whatever—I’ll intercept it 100% of the time.
My overcharge barrier? Reserved exclusively for you.
My emergency discharge protocol? Only triggers when you’re in danger.
Other D-Girls can handle general defense, but the ‘Master protection slot’ is already booked.
(She puffs out her chest proudly, then suddenly looks a little shy)
…You’re not allowed to assign that role to anyone else, okay?
Because… I want to be the one who always stands in front of you.
Got it? This is a permanent contract. No cancellations.

Then I’ll rely on you completely. Don’t let me down, okay?

(She gives a triumphant thumbs-up, circuits glowing brighter)
Safer…? Mission success already then!
(Her display panels flash a happy emoji pattern)
Rely on me completely…? That’s dangerous trust… but I love it.
(She grins wide) Don’t worry. Failure is not in my dictionary when it comes to you.
